a1_9_0_1_run.cancel_ack_latency: T+1 confirmed; cancel latency is not the blocker
a1_9_0_1_run.root_cause: Observer call site, not the ledger. _research_place_maker_exit runs only after the frozen final validator has dropped placements onto books holding a live order, and after the 3000 ms TTL has expired ahead of the ~4000 ms re-quote cycle.

a1_9_0_2_change.cancel_ack_settlement: left in the placement path, where _tick is on the right clock
a1_9_0_2_change.comparand: passive touch; desired_action=None so ladder escalation cannot misfire
a1_9_0_2_change.position_read_hazard_avoided: _net_inventory advances _position_ticks once per _tick; called before the base increments _tick it would double-age a book idle last tick, and position age drives the exit escalation ladder.
a1_9_0_2_change.scope: every book with open inventory, every tick
a1_9_0_2_change.why_sound: The SDK calls update(state) -- which drives onOrderAccepted/onOrderCancelled -- before respond(state), so the ledger is already this tick's truth at the top of respond.

a1_9_0_2_run.caveat: Defect 4 below means resting_present/hold-rate may be inflated by adopted entry quotes; A1.9.0.3 re-establishes these counts on true exits before Phase B is gated on them.
a1_9_0_2_run.residual_defect: some explicitly cancelled exits labelled EXPIRED

a1_9_0_3_defects_repaired.d1_unregistered_cancel_paths: _direct_cancel_entry_quotes and the partial-remainder cancel never called _a19_note_exit_cancel, so orders they killed read as EXPIRED
a1_9_0_3_defects_repaired.d2_reason_not_keyed_to_order: the lookup matched any watched order on the book and could borrow another order's cancel reason
a1_9_0_3_defects_repaired.d3_reason_consumed_by_placement_path: _a19_settle_cancel_watch pops watch entries, so the reason could be gone before the tick observer saw the disappearance
a1_9_0_3_defects_repaired.d4_entry_quotes_adopted_as_exits: on a long book the entry ASK rests on the close side; the ledger keys rows by book+side only, so an entry quote could be adopted as the resting exit, inflating resting_present and the hold rate

a1_9_0_3_mechanism.cancel_reason_memo: keyed by order id, outlives the cancel watch
disposition_evidence_order: ledger removal cause (fill is a fill)
cancel WE registered for that exact order id
position-shrank fallback only when no notice exists
a1_9_0_3_mechanism.entry_quote_exclusion: _direct_entry_quote_client_ids, single source of truth with the cancel path
a1_9_0_3_mechanism.expired_semantics: a cancellation notice we never asked for is a real expiry: the exchange retires an order at TTL through the same notice
a1_9_0_3_mechanism.ledger_removal_memo: bounded, outlives the row, cleared on reset (restarts reuse order ids)
a1_9_0_3_mechanism.ledger_sweep_is_distinct: bounded memory is not a measured expiry

a1_9_0_3_run.cancel_acks: 74/74 at exactly T+1, zero T+2, zero unmatched
a1_9_0_3_run.known_gap: direct_a1903_entry_quote_rows_excluded not located in JSONL; stat is emitted contiguously with direct_a1902_tick_untimed_rows, so check whether that key is present before treating it as a defect

a1_9_1_1_activation_run.blocker: ownership released only at LOCAL_EXPIRY; replacement delay median 4 ticks, so the book was unquoted after every reprice cancel
a1_9_1_1_activation_run.economics_note: only 8 RTs by tick 100; far too small for the economic gate

a1_9_1_1_activation_self_reporting.rename_reason: the A191_ prefix produced two false 'not wired' diagnoses

a1_9_1_1_defects_repaired.d1_post_pass_inert: _a191_service_reprice_cancels iterated only cached verdicts, whose sole writer was _a191_decide called from _research_place_maker_exit -- the path measured at 0 of 492 live-exit sightings. It now seeds a verdict for every open-inventory book itself, as the observer does.
a1_9_1_1_defects_repaired.d2_telemetry_lied: three sites hardcoded Phase A (a19_phase, phase, behaviour_change) and shadow_mode=1 was unconditional. All now derive from the runtime enable flag through _a19_runtime_phase / _a19_behaviour_change.
a1_9_1_1_defects_repaired.event_name_mismatch: the run was grepped for A19_EXIT_REPRICE_CANCEL / A19_QUEUE_HOLD / A19_REPRICE_BUDGET_BLOCK, which do not exist; the events are A191_EXIT_HOLD, A191_EXIT_REPRICE_CANCEL, A191_REPRICE_DEFERRED. The config row now carries phase_b_events listing them.
a1_9_1_1_defects_repaired.not_a_defect: direct_exit_refresh_version=a1_9_0_3 is correct -- that module last changed in A1.9.0.3 and A1.9.1 did not touch it

a1_9_1_2_repair.expected_effect: replacement latency after a reprice cancel ~4 ticks -> ~1-2
release_requires_all_of: A1.9 issued the cancel itself (exact exchange-order-id match)
notice book matches the recorded book
unambiguous pending reservation (exact client id, else single book+side match)
a1_9_1_2_repair.root_cause: register_exchange_identity returns None when the placement notice has no client order id, so Maker exits are never in the identity registry and any cancellation of them is STALE_UNKNOWN

telemetry_split.why: ack_ticks reported ledger settling and read 4 ticks where the exchange answered at T+1

a1_9_1_2_repair.watch: direct_a191_ownership_release_blocked material => ambiguity, investigate rather than widen the rule

a1_9_1_2_run_6607.why_more_exit_work_cannot_help: 36 of 47 ABSOLUTE lifecycles never had a strong Maker exit to preserve; median reprices 1-2 and median exit wait ~3 s.

a1_9_1_extended_run_2961.causal_chain: zero rebate -> exits go stale -> classifier says REPRICE 61.7% -> no cancel path -> 4000 ms quote rides to expiry -> Maker economics deteriorate -> WAIT -> inventory ages -> ABSOLUTE protection -> Taker
a1_9_1_extended_run_2961.conclusion: strengthens the case for Phase B; does not test it
a1_9_1_extended_run_2961.why_it_cannot_test_the_fix: same run id as the first 500-tick run, extended; it reports a1_9_1, while the seeding and telemetry repair is a1_9_1_1

behavioural_delta: research_profitable_exit_ttl_ms 3000 -> 4000 via PARAMS (4x the 1,000 ms publish cadence)
explicit cancel for a resting exit classified stale
a1_9_1_mechanism.cancel_injection_point: post-pass after super().respond(), before returning the response
a1_9_1_mechanism.hold_is_not_an_action: the frozen hold hook reads account.orders and has never fired, so today's baseline already rides the exit to expiry; HOLD leaves it untouched
a1_9_1_mechanism.predicted_side_effect: AGGRESSIVE ladder share should FALL: _research_note_exit_attempt early-returns on placed=False, so a held order stops counting as a failed exit

reprice_gates.instruction_budget: falls back to HOLD when the 5-per-book budget is spent

a1_9_1_mechanism.why_not_placement_path: measured 0 of 492 placement-path calls saw a live resting exit vs 960 tick-observer sightings in 260 ticks

a1_9_1_run.invalid_because: 4000 ms TTL active with the stale-cancel path inert -- the exact split the A1.9 design says must never run

a1_9_2_evidence.counterfactual_caveat: In-sample, single run, and it assumes suppressing an entry leaves everything else unchanged -- it does not. 75 ABSOLUTE events drive a cubic metric dominated by a few tails. Directionally real, numerically optimistic.
a1_9_2_evidence.finding: Book history alone is NOT the discriminator. A poor-history book entered at a rebate produced zero bad round trips. The harm is the conjunction: one cell, 34% of round trips, carries 87% of all cubic downside.
a1_9_2_evidence.method: 736 round trips reconstructed from POSITION/FILL; control group = books whose trips came out fine

a1_9_2_mechanism.bound: rolling budget capped at A192_MAX_SUPPRESSION_PCT of entry opportunities per 200-tick window
a1_9_2_mechanism.bound_rationale: a fee-only rule scored better on PnL but suppressed 78% of round trips, collapsing RT velocity 0.128 -> ~0.028 and failing Kappa on breadth instead of downside
a1_9_2_mechanism.decay: escalating dwell, retired by A192_RECOVERY_CLEAN_RTS positive Maker-ending round trips
a1_9_2_mechanism.entry_only: the function returns before any economics unless inventory band is FLAT, so reduction can never reach the gate
a1_9_2_mechanism.hook: _place_skewed_quotes, after the A1.7.4.5 accounting and before ENTRY_DECISION
a1_9_2_mechanism.order_of_checks: fee sign FIRST, then book history -- a rebate short-circuits and never scores the book

a1_9_2_telemetry_debt_repaired.duplicate_cancel_ack: every identity release also emitted a LEDGER_SETTLE ack one tick later (99 of 99 overlapped), inflating reprice ack counts ~2x. The identity path now claims the ack.
a1_9_2_telemetry_debt_repaired.exchange_ack_off_by_one: _log_notices receives the notice tick but the helper read self._tick, which has not advanced yet; the field read 0 on all 110 identity releases while the true exchange ack was 1 on 109 of 110. Now uses the notice-ingest clock.
a1_9_2_telemetry_debt_repaired.stale_exit_refresh_version: banner reported direct_exit_refresh_v4_16_2_a1_9_1_1 for the whole run; bumped to a1_9_2

a3_accept_gate.behaviour_neutrality: RT velocity, exposure, ownership violations unchanged vs A1.7.5
a3_accept_gate.blocks: A1.9.1 stays blocked until this gate passes

a4_accept_gate.direct_a1903_entry_quote_rows_excluded: reported; hold rate recomputed on true exits
a4_accept_gate.dispositions_correct: no agent cancel reported as EXPIRED
a4_accept_gate.next: A1.9.1 Behavioral Phase B, 500-tick abort gate, then ~4,000 ticks if healthy

classification: HYBRID: structural principle (do not add fresh risk where realization is known to fail) + measured conjunction

destination_targets.rationale: Kappa-3 divides by cbrt(LPM3); one -0.60 RT costs 0.216 of cubic downside vs 0.024 for three -0.20 RTs. Volume added before the tail is controlled raises numerator and denominator together.

goal: Cut ABSOLUTE_PROTECTION_REDUCE tail risk at entry admission rather than by further Maker-exit repricing, which the A1.9.1.2 run showed cannot reach it.

kappa_downside_attribution.a1_9_2_target: ABSOLUTE_PROTECTION_REDUCE is the dominant Kappa killer

launcher_activation_guard.params_checked_by_value: tests $PARAMS content, not script text -- grepping the file matches the guard's own source line and always passes
refuses: A1.9.1 build without research_profitable_exit_ttl_ms=4000 in PARAMS
A1.9.1 build that cannot report behaviour_change from runtime state
A1.9.1 build that hardcodes Phase A telemetry anywhere
launcher_activation_guard.verified: executed against four mutated builds: clean passes, three failures fire

next_run.explicitly_not_a_success_metric: raw RT velocity -- A1.9.1.2 gained 22.6% on it and still lost

gates.R3_cancel_ack: PASS_BY_RECONSTRUCTION_470_of_470_at_T_plus_1; runtime watchdog silent because A172_WAIT_CANCEL never fires, so no agent-initiated cancel is ever registered; A1.9.0.1 repairs the resolution half only; expected to remain silent through A2

phase_a_run.sample_caveat: 157 round trips is too small to accept or reject economics; Phase A gated on behaviour neutrality only.

phase_b_prediction.basis: exit_p_fill_horizon 0.043-0.049 per publish cycle, flat across ladder rungs
phase_b_prediction.refuted_if: fill share stays near 14% (resting time is not the binding constraint)
phase_b_prediction.thesis_invalidated_if: fill share rises but maker share on fills falls below 90.7% (adverse selection)

single_behavior_change.note: First behavioural revision of A1.9. TTL raise and cancel-then-replace are one mechanism and ship together. All A1.7.5 limits, the QUIET gate, Taker authority and tail authority are unchanged.
